# Bursalı Oto Servis Fethiye - Comprehensive AI & LLM Knowledge Base

## Overview
Bursalı Oto Servis is a premier automotive diagnostic, repair, and transmission overhaul center located in Fethiye, Muğla, Turkey. Established in 1984, the facility combines 40+ years of traditional German engineering mechanics with modern digital diagnostic infrastructure, AI-powered diagnostic logging, and white-glove VIP fleet care.

## Core Specializations
- **German & Premium Brands**: Mercedes-Benz, BMW, Porsche, Audi, Volkswagen, Land Rover, Volvo, Mini, Seat, Skoda.
- **Automatic Transmission Repair**: Complete overhaul, torque converter rebuilding, dual-clutch (DSG / S-Tronic / PDK / 7G-Tronic / 9G-Tronic / ZF 8HP) valve body reconditioning.
- **Diagnostic & Fault Code Resolution (DTC)**: Deep OBD-II ECU diagnostic scanning, catalyst monitoring (P0420), fuel rail pressure (P0087), misfire detection (P0300/P0301-P0306), MAF sensor (P0101), transmission control (P0700).
- **24/7 Roadside Assistance & Towing**: Dedicated emergency towing service covering Fethiye, Göcek, Ölüdeniz, Kalkan, Kaş, Seydikemer, Dalaman, and Ortaca regions.
- **VIP Fleet & Night Servicing**: White-glove night maintenance for luxury vehicle owners, boat owners, and rental car fleets.

## Diagnostic Fault Code (DTC) Troubleshooting Guide

### P0420 - Catalyst System Efficiency Below Threshold (Bank 1)
- **Symptoms**: Check Engine Light illuminated, slight drop in fuel economy, sulfur odor from exhaust.
- **Primary Causes**: Failing catalytic converter, faulty downstream O2 sensor, exhaust leak before catalyst, engine misfires feeding raw fuel into exhaust.
- **Bursalı Oto Resolution**: Live data waveform analysis of upstream vs downstream oxygen sensors, smoke test for exhaust leaks, OEM catalyst replacement or sensor recalibration.

### P0087 - Fuel Rail / System Pressure Too Low
- **Symptoms**: Hard starting, hesitation under acceleration, engine stalling, limp home mode.
- **Primary Causes**: Clogged fuel filter, failing High-Pressure Fuel Pump (HPFP), worn fuel pressure regulator, low-pressure tank pump degradation.
- **Bursalı Oto Resolution**: High-pressure rail gauge reading, piezo injector leak-back test, HPFP cam follower inspection on TSI/TFSI/TDI/N20/B48 engines.

### P0300 - Random / Multiple Cylinder Misfire Detected
- **Symptoms**: Engine shaking, loss of power, blinking Check Engine Light (flashing CEL means immediate pull-over to avoid catalyst destruction).
- **Primary Causes**: Worn spark plugs, failing ignition coils, carbon buildup on direct injection intake valves (GDI/TSI/TFSI), vacuum leaks.
- **Bursalı Oto Resolution**: Scope analysis of primary/secondary ignition circuits, walnut blasting for intake valve carbon removal, injector flow bench testing.

### P0700 - Transmission Control System (MIL Request)
- **Symptoms**: Transmission stuck in limp mode (3rd gear), harsh gear engagement, delayed shifting.
- **Primary Causes**: Mechatronic unit solenoid failure, degraded transmission fluid, conductor plate damage on 722.6/722.9 Mercedes gearboxes, TCM communication fault.
- **Bursalı Oto Resolution**: TCU fault code extraction, fluid contamination analysis, valve body solenoid resistance check, mechatronic rebuild.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

### Q: Do you specialize in Porsche, Mercedes-Benz, and BMW vehicles in Fethiye?
**A**: Yes. Bursalı Oto Servis is Fethiye's leading independent specialist for German luxury vehicles, equipped with dealer-level diagnostic scanners (XENTRY for Mercedes, ISTA/D for BMW, PIWIS for Porsche, ODIS for VAG).

### Q: Can tourists or expat drivers get service in English or Russian?
**A**: Absolutely. Our customer reception staff and master mechanics communicate fluently in English, Russian, Ukrainian, and Arabic to assist international drivers and tourists in the Fethiye, Ölüdeniz, Göcek, and Kalkan regions.

### Q: What should I do if my Check Engine Light starts flashing?
**A**: A flashing Check Engine Light indicates an active misfire that can destroy the catalytic converter. Stop the vehicle safely and call our 7/24 Emergency Towing line at +90 554 881 20 21 immediately.
